// diagnostic

E0936

An impl gives a constant its trait does not declare

What

An impl gives a constant its trait does not declare

Why

An implementation gives only the constants its trait declares

Fix

Remove the constant, or declare `name: Type` in the trait

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0936: tests/ui/marker_impl_rejected_members.stderr.

Error [E0937]: The `impl Marker` block gives `sites` twice
  --> tests/ui/marker_impl_rejected_members.jet:9:9
    |
  9 |         sites :: [.Method]
    |         ^^^^^
 Why: A marker has one value for each setting
 Fix: Remove one `sites :: …`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0937

Error [E0936]: `colour` is not a setting of `Marker`
  --> tests/ui/marker_impl_rejected_members.jet:10:9
    |
 10 |         colour :: .Red
    |         ^^^^^^
 Why: An `impl Marker` block gives only the settings a marker has: sites, repeatable, owns_menu, inherits, resolution, scopes, companion
 Fix: Remove `colour`, or write one of the marker settings
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0936

Error [E0105]: `fn expand` is defined twice in `impl Marker`
  --> tests/ui/marker_impl_rejected_members.jet:15:12
    |
 15 |         fn expand(self, target: Target) {}
    |            ^^^^^^
 Why: A marker has one template
 Fix: Remove one of the definitions
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0105

Error [E0907]: `render` is not a method of `Marker`
  --> tests/ui/marker_impl_rejected_members.jet:17:9
    |
 17 |         fn render(self) {}
    |         ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `impl Marker` has one method, the template the compiler expands with the marked item bound to `target`
 Fix: Write `fn expand(self, target: Target) { … }`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0907

Error [E0908]: `Traced` has a second `impl Marker` block
  --> tests/ui/marker_impl_rejected_members.jet:20:5
    |
 20 |     impl Marker {
    |     ^^^^
 Why: A struct declares one marker, so its settings, group and template share one block
 Fix: Move these members into the first `impl Marker` block
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0908

Error [E0999]: The marker group `Traced` has fields, settings or a template
  --> tests/ui/marker_impl_rejected_members.jet:4:8
    |
  4 | struct Traced {
    |        ^^^^^^
 Why: A group names a fixed marker stack, so a use site passes nothing into it and it expands to its members
 Fix: Remove everything but `group :: #[…]`, or declare a marker without a group
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0999
